app.name: FWMS
app.tagline: Field precision. Strict security. Trusted Moroccan payroll.

landing.heroTitle: Manage your field workforce with geographic precision and reliable payroll
landing.heroSubtitle: One platform for security, cleaning, landscaping, construction and crafts: location-bound attendance, smart scheduling, and complete payslips under the Moroccan Labour Code — CNSS, AMO and IR — from gross to net.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Every module follows the reference specification and integrates seamlessly
landing.featureSchedulingDesc: Recurring daily and weekly programs, rotating shifts, and ready-made sector templates: night watches for security, daytime hours for construction, multi-site distribution for cleaning — with shift-conflict prevention.
landing.featureGeofencingDesc: Check-in and check-out bound to each site's point and radius (geofencing), verified on the server rather than the app, with mock-location detection and logging of rejected attempts.
landing.featurePayrollDesc: Complete calculation in dirham (stored in cents): hours, night and rest-day overtime, deductions and bonuses, then CNSS, AMO and income tax — values held as dated data, never hard-coded constants.
landing.featureDeclarationsDesc: CNSS (Damancom) and DGI (SIMPL-IR) file generation through an accountant-reviewed approval cycle, with a versioned specification registry — no file is exported before approval.
landing.featureReportsDesc: Payslips and statements as PDF, DOCX and image, with correct Arabic fonts and full RTL, for every level: employee, supervisor, manager and owner — with a digital verification mark.
landing.featureSecurityDesc: Each company's data fully isolated, five roles always verified server-side, an audit trail for every sensitive action, and strict authentication with optional 2FA.
landing.techSubtitle: The same code runs in the cloud (Vercel + Cloudflare) and on your local server — only configuration differs
landing.techItem1Desc: Automatic deployment via GitHub/Vercel, plus a local Termux server reachable over LAN or a secure Cloudflare tunnel.
landing.techItem2Desc: Lightweight, fast SQLite for local operation, with a schema ready to upgrade to PostgreSQL as you scale.
landing.techItem3Desc: An immutable audit log: who acted, when, before/after and why — full review transparency.
landing.techItem4Desc: Arabic (RTL), French, English and Spanish — interface and reports, with no machine translation.
landing.footerRights: Platform ownership is customizable and transferable
